    // Compute length and direction cosines
    Vector3d vec = ptB - ptA;
    Real L = std::sqrt(vec.dot(vec)); // Use explicit dot product for precision
    if (L == 0.0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Rod length is zero");
    }
    
    Vector3d n = vec / L; // direction cosines
    
    // Build the 3x3 "N" matrix: n * n^T
    Matrix3d N = n * n.transpose();
    
    // Compute axial stiffness coefficient
    Real k_axial = E * A / L;
    
    // Initialize 6x6 stiffness matrix
    Matrix6d K = Matrix6d::Zero();
    
    // Fill axial part following standard CROD formulation:
    // K = k_axial * [  N   -N ]
    //                [ -N    N ]
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
            K(i, j) = k_axial * N(i, j);           // top-left block: +N
            K(i+3, j+3) = k_axial * N(i, j);       // bottom-right block: +N
            K(i, j+3) = -k_axial * N(i, j);        // top-right block: -N
            K(i+3, j) = -k_axial * N(i, j);        // bottom-left block: -N
        }
    }
    
    return K;
}

// Format a double in scientific notation with fixed precision
std::string formatDouble(Real value) {
    std::ostringstream oss;
    oss << std::scientific << std::setprecision(15) << value;
    std::string s = oss.str();
    // Remove trailing zeros after decimal point
    size_t pos = s.find_last_not_of('0');
    if (pos != std::string::npos && s[pos] == '.') {
        s.erase(pos + 1);
    } else if (pos != std::string::npos) {
        s.erase(pos + 1);
    }
    return s;
}
